weights.quantization_note: llama.cpp refuses to requantize from Q8_0, so Q4_K_M requires a fresh BF16 conversion. Q8_0 carries less quantization noise into a measured run and fits a 7B in 16 GB of RAM.

runtime.constrained_decoding_note: response_format json_object is accepted by llama-server and not enforced on the build measured here; only grammar binds.
runtime.required_server_flags_note: llama-server defaults to four slots and divides --ctx-size between them, so --parallel 1 is required or each request receives a quarter of the window.

intended_use: Stock/reference OI substrate before OI-specific behavioral training. Model weights provide language and reasoning, not citable Orthodox evidence.

measurements.measured_on: CPU only, no GPU, 16 GB RAM
measurements.note: Indicative, single-machine, CPU-bound. Recorded so a later GPU measurement has something to be compared against, not as an acceptance figure.
